note: Intentionally empty. See PARAMETERS.md. Populating this with anything other than a reviewed, citable regional calendar would make AgriSense rank crops on a guess, which every other part of the system is built to refuse.

required_record_shape.evidence_id: must match an id in this file's evidence list
required_record_shape.latitude_min: number, -90..90, the region this calendar is valid for
required_record_shape.sowing_start_month_day: MM-DD, start of the local sowing window
required_record_shape.sowing_end_month_day: MM-DD, end of the local sowing window
required_record_shape.minimum_climate_days: integer, >= 30, complete historical days required before ranking
required_record_shape.seasonal_irrigation_mm: number, >= 0, reviewed regional seasonal irrigation requirement
required_record_shape.planned_cost_inr_ha: number, >= 0, reviewed regional cost of cultivation
